title: PHP CGI argument injection on Windows (CVE-2024-4577)
summary: CVE-2024-4577 affects PHP running in CGI mode on Windows due to Best-Fit character conversion. Linux Apache module deployments are a different runtime shape. If the production operating system and SAPI cannot be established, exposure is unknown.
remediation: Establish the production OS and SAPI before claiming a fix. A Linux container image is not proof of the production host. If Windows CGI is confirmed, upgrade PHP to a patched release or stop using CGI.
